evidence.title: Visual Inspiration and Creative References — Clipppy

name: Clipppy
summary: Visual bookmarking app: save images, links, videos and notes as clips in collections, and browse what the community saves.
description: A place for visual thinkers to keep what they find: images, GIFs, links, videos, PDFs, products and notes become clips, organised into collections and shareable boards that can be searched again. An explore feed shows clips saved by the community. Free plan with unlimited clips, boards and notes and 500 MB storage; Plus is $10 per month or $84 per year for 50 GB storage and unlimited guests.
